title: Implement MealPlan Serialisation
description: Add `MealPlanParser.serialise(_:)` so parsed meal plans round-trip back to stable CookLang `.menu` text that reparses to an equivalent model, preserving the spec's formatting semantics where required.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlanParser.serialise(_:)` emits optional frontmatter, block headings, section headers, comments, and item lines in a form accepted by `parse(_:)`.
`serialise(parse(x))` reparses to an equal `MealPlan` for canonical sample content.
Whitespace and trailing-newline handling is stable enough for round-trip equality at the model level.
